t.why: NATO's eastern front line, bordering Ukraine and Russia, it has sharply raised defense spending.
t.rel: Bordering Ukraine, Belarus and Russia's Kaliningrad exclave, it is NATO's eastern front line. Since the war in Ukraine it has raised defense spending to over 4% of GDP.
t.korea: It has bought Korean tanks, howitzers and fighter jets on a huge scale, making it Korea's biggest defense partner. Korean battery plants are there too.
t.know: Inside the Wieliczka salt mine is a chapel whose walls and chandeliers are carved from salt.
t.etext: It grew fast into a manufacturing powerhouse selling car parts, appliances, furniture and food to Europe. Since joining the EU it has grown for a long time without recession. It is sharply raising defense spending.
